market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL CME settlement ≥$115 by end of June requires ~9-14% upside from current $101-105. Hormuz crisis supports upside, but settlement (not intraday) is harder. ~2 months runway. Estimate ~30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Geopolitical escalation could fast-track $115; settlement basis matters
